C16_run3_optical_thickness.note: stage-2 knots, natural cubic spline; group index n + f dn/df

sigma_note.text: Run 3 (Sec. 8) averages 3000 waveforms over a 115 ps window; the Sec. 5 trace averages 1000 waveforms over 80 ps. Its pre-pulse std (first 10 ps) is 9.0e-04 vs 2.9e-04 because two 2-ps segments of its pre-pulse carry bursts (std 1.1e-03 at 4-6 ps and 1.7e-03 at 8-10 ps; other segments 6.9e-05-1.7e-04); its white (first-difference) level is lower, 2.7e-05 vs 4.5e-05.

C12_cramer_rao_and_profiles.jacobian: central differences, steps n 1e-6, kappa 1e-7, d 1e-10 m

profiles.method: Gauss-Newton conditional warm start + 1500 Adam iterations (lr 0.0001) with the constraint projected after every step; loss = stage-2 loss (MAE + log-cosh + hinge)
